request.description: One reusable TOP LEFT CORNER of a chunky violet dungeon stone UI BOARD FRAME, with two short straight rails making an L. Orthographic front view, no perspective. A compact purple DIAMOND jewel fitting about 17 native pixels across at the joint, seated in a dark violet stone socket with a subdued pale stone/silver upper-left bevel. Each rail is 9 native pixels thick, extends 35 pixels from the corner; chunky squared violet stone blocks with broad quiet planes, one narrow dark seam per large block. Small square stone connector farther along one rail. Transparent negative space on all sides and inside L. Pixel art native grid, bold dark outline, controlled top-left lighting, minimal detail; compare the reference only for clean contour and broad shading discipline. This is isolated modular frame hardware, not a complete frame or screen. No skull, character, letters, floor, vines, filigree, cracked surfaces, cobblestones, repeated diamonds along rails, soft glow, blur or dithering.
